insightTech: AI music landscape shifting: Suno/Udio settled lawsuits, now paying licensing fees. ElevenLabs entered the race. Major labels launching licensed AI platforms. Stock music market being commoditized by AI generators. New VSTs (Serum 2, MOSAIQ) still relevant alongside AI tools. Google and Apple now embedding AI music in core apps.
insightStrategy: Musio+ Complete differentiates through bundling real instruments from multiple developers - AI can't replicate authentic human performance. Need visibility push before launch - Musio not appearing in current AI music discussions. Consider press outreach. UNESCO reports 24% income decline threat for music creators.
